from datetime import datetime

# Ensure token
if 'spotify_token' not in globals() or not spotify_token:
    passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    spotify_pw = next(p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='spotify')
    spotify_token = apis.spotify.login(username='caiburc@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']

current_year = datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# Ensure recommendations list exists
if 'all_recs' not in globals() or not all_recs:
    page_limit = 20
    page_index = 0
    all_recs = []
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('page_index', page_index, 'page_len', len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        all_recs.extend(page)
        page_index += 1

print('total_recommendations', len(all_recs))

# Deduplicate
song_ids = []
seen=set()
for r in all_recs:
    sid = r.get('song_id')
    if sid is not None and sid not in seen:
        seen.add(sid)
        song_ids.append(sid)
print('unique_recommended_song_ids', len(song_ids))

matched=[]
nonmatched=[]

for sid in song_ids:
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre = details.get('genre')
    release_date = details.get('release_date')
    release_year = None
    if release_date:
        release_year = str(release_date)[:4]
    ok_genre = (genre == 'R&B')
    ok_year = (release_year == str(current_year))
    if ok_genre and ok_year:
        matched.append(sid)
    else:
        nonmatched.append((sid, genre, release_year, details.get('title')))

print('matched_count', len(matched))
print('matched_song_ids', matched)
print('sample_nonmatched_first_10', nonmatched[:10])

from datetime import datetime

def ensure_spotify_token():
    global spotify_token
    if 'spotify_token' in globals() and spotify_token:
        return spotify_token
    passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    spotify_pw = next(p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='spotify')
    spotify_token = apis.spotify.login(username='caiburc@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)['access_token']
    return spotify_token

spotify_token = ensure_spotify_token()

playlist_title = 'R&B Recommendation'

# Fetch all playlists in library to find exact title match
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_playlists = []
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('playlists_page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(all_playlists))
matching = [p for p in all_playlists if p.get('title') == playlist_title]
print('matching_count', len(matching))
if matching:
    print('matching_playlist_ids', [p['playlist_id'] for p in matching])

# songs already matched earlier
matched_song_ids = [87, 184]

if matching:
    playlist_id = matching[0]['playlist_id']
else:
    resp = apis.spotify.create_playlist(title=playlist_title, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('create_playlist_resp', resp)
    playlist_id = resp['playlist_id']

print('target_playlist_id', playlist_id)

# Check existing songs in playlist to avoid duplicates
pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
existing_song_ids = set([s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs', [])]) if pl.get('songs') is not None else set()
print('existing_song_count', len(existing_song_ids))
print('existing_song_ids_intersection', sorted(list(existing_song_ids & set(matched_song_ids))))

songs_to_add = [sid for sid in matched_song_ids if sid not in existing_song_ids]
print('songs_to_add', songs_to_add, 'count', len(songs_to_add))

for sid in songs_to_add:
    res = apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('added', sid, 'res', res)

# Verify final playlist contents
pl2 = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_token)
final_song_ids = set([s['id'] for s in pl2.get('songs', [])]) if pl2.get('songs') is not None else set()
print('final_song_count', len(final_song_ids))
print('final_intersection_with_matched', sorted(list(final_song_ids & set(matched_song_ids))))
print('missing_from_final', sorted(list(set(matched_song_ids) - final_song_ids)))
